intro: Designed for evolving work styles, our Excella1 offers touch-enabled height adjustment, durable support, and smart add-ons for an efficient, ergonomic workspace at home or school.

features.title: Touch-controlled height
features.text: With a smooth motorized lift, this desk adjusts from 735 mm to 1180 mm at a touch—ideal for switching between seated and standing tasks without interrupting your flow.

features.title: All-metal durability
features.text: A robust metal frame provides exceptional strength and stability, ensuring your setup stays secure and steady during long hours of study or work.

features.title: Strong 70 kg tabletop
features.text: The tabletop easily supports up to 70 kg—perfect for books, monitors, and study essentials without the worry of sagging or instability.

features.title: Handy hanging hooks
features.text: Integrated hooks on both sides let you hang bags, headphones, or personal items, keeping your space clean, accessible, and clutter-free.

features.title: Safety-first edges
features.text: Gently curved edges enhance user safety by minimizing sharp corners—great for kids’ rooms or fast-paced work environments.

features.title: Level on any floor
features.text: Adjustable bush feet ensure your desk stays balanced, even on uneven surfaces—making it ideal for any room in your home or office.

name: Excella1 Particle Board Height Adjustable Touch Study Table
